fee_notes: Multiple franchise types: Standard $59,900 (750K-1M population), Small Market $44,925 (400K-749K population), Conversion $20,000-$40,000. Standard and Small Market offer $10,000 discount for multiple simultaneous purchases.
raw_excerpt: Standard Franchise: Upon signing the Franchise Agreement for a Standard Franchise, you must pay an initial franchise fee of $59,900. Small Market Franchise: Upon signing of the Franchise Agreement for a Small Market Franchise, you must pay an initial franchise fee of $44,925. Conversion Franchise (from Item 7 Table): Initial Franchise Fee $20,000 $40,000.
